property_summary: After any sequence of calls to addToBalance, the caller's own balance (msg.sender at call time) must increase by exactly the sum of msg.values they sent, while the address(0) balance must remain 0; the mutant redirects the increase to address(0), violating this invariant.
change_summary: Change the balance update to use address(0) instead of msg.sender, so the caller's balance never changes but another key is affected.
